request.style: English, solemn female solo voice with choral harmony, organ, cello, flute, harp, soft drums, reverent and mournful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother
His mother's sister and Mary the wife of Clopas
Mary Magdalene watched the suffering
They followed him from Galilee with care
Serving his needs in the quiet hours

[Verse]
Many women were there watching from a distance
They had followed Jesus from Galilee to Jerusalem
Caring for his needs while he was there
Now they stood before the place of death
The day of Preparation was nearly done

[Verse]
It was evening and the Sabbath was near
Joseph of Arimathea went boldly to Pilate
He asked for the body of Jesus
Pilate was surprised that he was already dead
The centurion confirmed the final breath

[Verse]
Joseph bought a linen cloth for the burial
He took him down and wrapped him in the linen
Laid him in a tomb cut out of rock
Then he rolled a stone against the entrance
Mary Magdalene saw where he was laid

[Verse]
Mary the mother of Joses saw the place
She witnessed the grave and the rolling stone
Faithful witness at the cross and tomb
They kept the memory of his suffering
The women watched in the fading light
